_instructions.purpose: Use this template to create a new Introductory Ride entry for introductory-rides.json
howToUse: 2. Paste it into the 'events' array in introductory-rides.json
3. Fill in all the fields following the guidance below
4. Remove any fields marked as OPTIONAL if not needed
5. Save introductory-rides.json and rebuild the site

fieldGuide.title: The ride name as it appears in the calendar
fieldGuide.meetPoint.name: Meeting location name
fieldGuide.meetPoint.googleMapsUrl: Google Maps link to meeting point
fieldGuide.meetPoint.note: OPTIONAL - Extra info about meeting point
fieldGuide.guidance: Brief description of the ride - distance, terrain, pace, etc.

rideGuidelines: Introductory rides are designed for newcomers to cycling or the club
Typically 8-12 miles on flat, traffic-free routes
No one gets left behind - the group stays together
Perfect first step before joining regular rides

newRide.title: Intro Ride Title
newRide.guidance: Gentle ride on flat paths. Perfect for newcomers. No one left behind!
